summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). All empirical items are PENDING. Q1 (arrivals, length of stay, spending per visitor), Q2 (BoP travel receipts) and Q3 (carrying capacity at major destinations) are designed but unanswered. Twenty-eight source leads: Nepal Tourism Statistics 2023 and 2024 (MoCTCA/NTB), NRB Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation releases (BoP travel credits), BPM6, UNCTADstat, CAAN, WTO TPR 2025, World Bank NDU, IPCC and ICIMOD hazard documents, and - from the single permitted WebSearch - the UNESCO World Heritage 2021 State of Conservation record for Sagarmatha National Park and academic/UNDP studies on visitor impacts in Sagarmatha and Annapurna. Five portals (NTB, UN Tourism, DNPWC, NTNC, OCR) are marked as general-knowledge URLs. Arrivals (calendar year) and travel receipts (Nepal FY) are kept as separate series; per-arrival ratios require monthly re-aggregation. No official carrying-capacity determination was located. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: International tourist arrivals, total and by nationality, mode (air/land) and purpose.
findings.note: Calendar-year series; Indian land arrivals coverage differs across years; keep separate from FY receipts. Leads: 12C-L01..L04, L11

findings.claim: Average length of stay of international visitors.
findings.note: Method (departure card vs survey) to be recorded per edition. Leads: 12C-L01, L02

findings.claim: Average spending per visitor per day and per visit (as published by MoCTCA).
findings.note: Per visitor-day and per visit both stored as USD_per_person with the basis stated in the claim note. Leads: 12C-L01, L02

findings.claim: Implied receipts per arrival: BoP travel credits (FY) divided by arrivals (CY converted to FY by documented monthly aggregation).
findings.note: Estimate; requires monthly arrivals to build FY totals — never divide FY receipts by CY arrivals directly. Leads: 12C-L01, L05..L07
BPM6 travel; USD series with exchange-rate effect separated. Leads: 12C-L05..L09
Converted with NRB FY-average rate, documented. Leads: 12C-L05, L06

findings.claim: Travel exports, calendar-year (UNCTAD/UN Tourism inbound expenditure).
findings.note: Separate series; differs from NRB FY series by period and possibly by compilation. Leads: 12C-L10, L11

findings.claim: Travel receipts share of total services exports and of current-account receipts.
findings.note: Coordinate with 21E services matrix. Leads: 12C-L05, L06

findings.claim: Protected-area visitor counts: Sagarmatha NP, Annapurna CA, Langtang NP, Chitwan NP, and mountaineering permits (Everest).
findings.period: FY or CY as published (label per source)
findings.note: DNPWC/NTNC records; MoCTCA statistics tables. Leads: 12C-L01, L02, L21, L22

findings.claim: Environmental/social carrying-capacity limits at major destinations (quantified capacity, method, year).
findings.note: No official carrying-capacity determination located; UNESCO requested an SNP study (2021 SOC). Academic figures must be traced to original studies and labelled with method; not adopted as policy limits. Leads: 12C-L13..L20

findings.claim: International air-seat and airport throughput capacity (TIA, Gautam Buddha, Pokhara) as a binding constraint on arrivals.
Business formation: new company registrations and tourism-industry registrations by FY.
Arrivals (calendar year) and travel receipts (Nepal fiscal year) are kept as separate series; any per-visitor ratio uses monthly arrivals re-aggregated to FY.
Carrying capacity is treated as destination-specific and multidimensional (ecological, infrastructure, social); a single national capacity number is not constructed.
findings.note: Method choice; academic capacity figures are context, not constraints, until adopted in a management plan.

findings.claim: Tourism growth in scenarios enters GDP only through accommodation/food and related value added.

data_gaps: Every empirical value: no primary document could be downloaded in r1.
No official carrying-capacity determination for any Nepali destination located; UNESCO-requested SNP study status unknown.
DNPWC and NTNC protected-area entry records not located at document level.
Nepal Tourism Statistics 2025 edition not located.
Monthly arrival series needed for FY re-aggregation not yet located in machine-readable form.

assumptions.text: Arrivals CY and receipts FY kept separate.
Carrying capacity treated per destination and dimension; no national cap constructed.
Tourism enters GDP only via value added.

challenges.text: Travel credits are owned by 12C for the tourism baseline and by 21E within the services matrix; use one NRB series with shared observation ids.
DNPWC, NTNC and Nepal Tourism Board are not in the source catalog; propose adding them (tier 1 for DNPWC/NTB; NTNC as statutory trust) for protected-area visitor and capacity data.
Please provide hazard-exposure layers for Sagarmatha, Annapurna and Langtang tourism corridors so capacity constraints include climate risk.

uncertainty: High: no value retrieved. Structural uncertainties: (i) CY arrivals vs FY receipts; (ii) spending-per-visitor methods change across MoCTCA editions and may not reconcile with BoP; (iii) Indian visitor coverage; (iv) capacity studies are academic, site- and method-specific, and not policy limits; (v) climate hazards and air-capacity constraints can bind before ecological limits; (vi) the tourism-GDP link runs through value added and is sensitive to import leakage.

methodological_issues: length-of-stay and spending methods change across editions

series.name: implied_receipts_per_arrival
series.method: FY travel credits / FY-reaggregated arrivals; estimate

receipts_series.reconciliation: MoCTCA spending-based estimates vs NRB BoP travel credits are kept both; differences (informal exchange, INR receipts, package-tour payments abroad, passenger transport classification) documented.

destinations.note: UNESCO SOC 2021 requested a carrying-capacity study; whether one has been completed is pending.

destinations.site: Chitwan NP, Langtang NP, Kathmandu Valley heritage sites

capacity_constraints.climate_overlay: Glacier retreat and GLOF/flood hazards as time-varying constraints (link Agent 25/13)
capacity_constraints.note: No capacity value is asserted; academic figures seen in search snippets are not evidence and are not recorded.
